Lets approved Theta tools read the screen and control apps. Enable only if you want to use screen tools without Root. Tool permission rules still apply.

Focus an editable text field and enable Theta screen control in Accessibility settings, then retry.

Android did not accept the screen action. Check that Theta screen control is enabled.
